$comment: Gallery entries (docs/PLAN-R4.md section 4.5, C7). One entry per component in packages/components/metadata; scripts/prepare.mjs fails when a component is missing or unknown. `featured` components also appear under Enterprise and get large cards.

accordion.blurb: Stacked sections that expand and collapse, following the APG pattern.

alert.blurb: Page or section status in info, success, warning, and error tones.

avatar.blurb: Person picture with initials and icon fallbacks and a presence status.

avatar-group.blurb: Overlapping avatars with a +N overflow, named for screen readers.

badge.blurb: Short static status or category label with tones, dot, and icon.

bar-chart.blurb: Accessible bar and column charts for comparing categories.

bottom-sheet.blurb: A panel anchored to the bottom edge, built on native dialog.

box-plot.blurb: Compare distributions per category with quartiles and outliers.

breadcrumb.blurb: Show where a page sits in the hierarchy, with overflow handling.

bullet-chart.blurb: One measure against a target and qualitative ranges.

business-calendar.blurb: Working weeks, holidays, and exceptions in one editable calendar.

button.blurb: Primary, secondary, and tertiary actions with loading states.

button-group.blurb: Related actions presented as one labelled group.

calendar.blurb: A month grid for browsing and choosing dates, with date limits.

calendar-heatmap.blurb: A year of daily values with weekends and holidays from the business calendar.

candlestick-chart.blurb: Open-high-low-close prices on a trading-day axis, with volume and moving averages.

card.blurb: Surfaces for grouping content, with header, body, and actions.

carousel.blurb: APG carousel with inert hidden slides, swipe, and a pause button for autoplay.

cascader.blurb: Cascading menus for hierarchies, with lazy loading, path search, and multi-select.

chat.blurb: AI assistant chat: streamed replies with Stop and Retry, safe Markdown, and attachments.

checkbox.blurb: A single on/off choice on a native checkbox.

checkbox-group.blurb: Several independent choices in a labelled fieldset.

code-viewer.blurb: Read-only code with highlighting, line numbers, copy, and unified or split diffs.

collapsible.blurb: A single disclosure for optional details, following the APG pattern.

color-picker.blurb: Color area, hue and opacity, typed values, swatches, eyedropper, and contrast hint.

combo-chart.blurb: Bars, lines, and areas over shared categories.

command-palette.blurb: Ctrl+K command search: fuzzy matches, recent commands, nested pages, and async providers.

context-menu.blurb: Actions on right-click or the keyboard menu key.

dashboard.blurb: A JSON-configured, API-driven dashboard with editing and a widget builder.

dashboard-grid.blurb: A responsive, rearrangeable grid for dashboard widgets.

data-grid.blurb: Spreadsheet-like grid: a million rows, pinned and grouped columns, full keyboard.

data-table.blurb: Sorting, filters, selection, pinning, virtual rows, and CSV export.

date-input.blurb: Keyboard-first date entry in locale-ordered segments.

date-picker.blurb: Date field with segmented entry and a calendar popup.

date-range-picker.blurb: Inclusive date ranges in one field, with a two-month calendar.

date-time-picker.blurb: An exact moment, entered in the configured time zone.

diagram.blurb: Flowcharts with auto-layout, keyboard editing, undo, and SVG or PNG export.

discussion.blurb: Threaded comments with replies at any depth, @mentions, and relative timestamps.

dialog.blurb: Modal dialogs on native dialog with managed focus.

drawer.blurb: A panel that slides in from any screen edge.

duration-picker.blurb: Enter durations in days, hours, minutes, and seconds.

empty-state.blurb: Explains an empty table, list, or search and offers the next step.

error-summary.blurb: Every error after submit, each linked to its field.

fieldset.blurb: Legend, help, required marker, and group errors for a native fieldset.

file-manager.blurb: Folders, list and grid views, rename, move, delete, and uploads via your own provider.

file-upload.blurb: File picker with drag and drop, type, and size validation.

form.blurb: Validation and state management for a native form.

form-builder.blurb: Drag-and-drop and keyboard form designer with live preview, JSON import, and undo.

form-field.blurb: Field chrome for your own native inputs.

funnel-chart.blurb: Sequential stages with conversion between them.

gantt.blurb: Project schedules with dependencies, milestones, and business days.

gauge.blurb: One value on a radial arc with qualitative bands.

heatmap.blurb: Values across two dimensions as a colour grid.

histogram.blurb: The distribution of raw values in adjacent bins.

hover-card.blurb: A rich preview on hover or keyboard focus.

image-viewer.blurb: Inline or lightbox gallery with zoom, pan, rotate, thumbnails, and crop to a Blob.

inline-message.blurb: Compact status shown next to the content it describes.

kanban.blurb: Workflow columns and swimlanes with accessible drag and drop.

kbd.blurb: Keyboard shortcuts as keycaps, shown for the platform in use.

layout.blurb: Container, stack, flex, grid, and divider primitives in CSS.

line-chart.blurb: Trends over time or categories, as lines or areas.

masked-input.blurb: Pattern masks for phones, IBANs, and codes, with paste handling and a stable caret.

mention-input.blurb: Plain-text comments with @people and #tag suggestions kept as structured mentions.

menu.blurb: An actions menu from a trigger button.

month-picker.blurb: Choose a calendar month without a day.

multi-select.blurb: Several values from a searchable list, shown as removable chips.

network-graph.blurb: Deterministic force layouts with groups, pinning, and neighbor-to-neighbor keyboard moves.

number-input.blurb: Locale-aware numbers, currency, percent, and units, with steps.

org-chart.blurb: Reporting hierarchies as a tidy tree, with editing.

otp-input.blurb: One-time passcodes, PINs, and recovery codes.

password-input.blurb: Password entry with a show/hide toggle.

pie-chart.blurb: Part-to-whole breakdowns as a pie or donut.

pivot-grid.blurb: Cross-tabulate and aggregate records by rows and columns.

popover.blurb: A non-modal dialog anchored to its trigger.

progress-bar.blurb: Determinate or indeterminate progress with a label.

prompt-input.blurb: Chat composer: Enter to send, attachments, a token counter hook, and slash commands.

quarter-picker.blurb: Choose a calendar or fiscal quarter.

radar-chart.blurb: Compare a few series across several axes.

radio-group.blurb: Exactly one choice from a short, visible set.

rating.blurb: Stars or any symbol with half steps, clearing, and a read-only display mode.

recurrence-picker.blurb: Edit how something repeats, with a readable summary.

scatter-chart.blurb: Scatter and bubble charts for correlations.

schedule-picker.blurb: Choose when something happens in one control.

scheduler.blurb: Day, week, month, agenda, and resource timeline views.

schema-form.blurb: A complete, validated form from a JSON Schema and UI schema, with conditions and arrays.

scroll-area.blurb: Native scrolling with edge fades and a keyboard-focusable region.

select.blurb: A single choice from a known list of options.

session-warning-dialog.blurb: Counts down to session expiry and offers to extend.

sidebar.blurb: Application side navigation with groups and collapse.

signature-pad.blurb: Smooth pen and touch signatures, undo, PNG and SVG export, and a typed alternative.

skeleton.blurb: Loading placeholders hidden from assistive technology.

slider.blurb: Single and range sliders with marks, RTL, and full keyboard support.

sortable-list.blurb: A reorderable list by pointer or keyboard.

sparkline.blurb: Word-sized trends for text, tables, and cards.

splitter.blurb: Resizable, collapsible panes following the APG window splitter pattern.

stat-card.blurb: A KPI with comparison, delta, and trend.

switch.blurb: An on/off setting that applies immediately.

tabs.blurb: Switch between related panels, following the APG pattern.

tag-group.blurb: Removable and selectable tags with keyboard support and announcements.

text-input.blurb: Single-line text with label, help, and validation.

textarea.blurb: Multi-line text with a character count.

time-picker.blurb: A wall-clock time in locale-ordered segments.

timeline.blurb: Activity and event timelines grouped by day, business-calendar aware, with load more.

toast.blurb: Transient notifications in a labelled region.

toggle-group.blurb: Toggle buttons for one setting, single or multiple, with roving focus.

tour.blurb: Guided product tours with a spotlight, progress, keyboard control, and focus restore.

transfer-list.blurb: Move items between searchable lists by keyboard, buttons, or drag; windowed lists.

tree-select.blurb: Pick one or several nodes of a hierarchy from a searchable tree popup.

tree-view.blurb: APG tree with lazy children, tri-state checkboxes, drag-and-drop, and virtualization.

treemap.blurb: Hierarchical part-to-whole data as nested rectangles.

typography.blurb: Headings, text, links, code, and prose from tokens.

upload-queue.blurb: Files being uploaded, with progress, retry, and cancel.

validation-message.blurb: A field message for error, warning, success, or info.

virtual-list.blurb: Windowed lists of 100,000+ items with listbox selection and infinite scroll.

waterfall-chart.blurb: How a value changes through a sequence of steps.
